Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Rajasthan 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Rajasthan · IN 
 
 No. CC/39/2011/100 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Pumping Station - Rajasthan Pkg-100" (water treatment),
 awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) ,
 has been completed in all respects on 13/12/2011 at a gross executed value of Rs. 1773.00 Lakh
 (Rupees 17.73 Crore Only). 
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Priya Patel. This certificate is issued for record
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Irrigation & Waterways Dept, Govt of Rajasthan
